name: Audio8 ASR Infinite (preview)

lineage.base_model: Voxtral Realtime 4B audio tower + Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct decoder
lineage.how_derived: audio tower initialised from Voxtral Realtime, projector and frame-length embedding random, decoder from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, all trained (card table)

purpose: Native streaming speech recognition that is as responsive as possible: selectable 80/120/160 ms clock, 240-560 ms delay, and unlimited-length 24/7 transcription via a rolling KV cache (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card badge, repo tag)
license.notes: No LICENSE file in the HF repo (404); badge links to the GitHub LICENSE, not opened.

architecture.kind: streaming speech LLM: causal audio tower (32 layers, hidden 1280, window 750) + Qwen2.5-3B decoder (36 layers, hidden 2048, 16 heads / 2 KV heads) + semantic-VAD heads
architecture.why_this_design: Builder states a native streaming architecture decoding 12.5 times per second, with semantic VAD to tell thinking pauses and stutters from end of turn (card).

variants.notes: model.safetensors 8.17 GB per card; plus semantic_vad_heads.safetensors

pc-12gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (9.6 GB)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 8.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 8.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 8.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: adapted vLLM build for the unlimited-length mode

benchmarks.name: AISHELL-1 test CER, 480 ms delay, 80 ms clock

strengths: Chinese+English streaming CER far below Voxtral Realtime on Mandarin
weaknesses: English only slightly worse than Voxtral Realtime 2602
preview, formal release still in progress
soft.maturity: 878 likes in two months, anonymous-ish small org.

tona_fit.reason: Chinese/English only; German users get nothing. Relevant only as a design reference for rolling-KV streaming ASR.

sources.note: README incl. architecture and evaluation tables, config.json, HF API
